note: Per-million-token USD rates. Cache multipliers are relative to each model's input rate. Every active (non-retired) entry below was re-verified live against source_url on 2026-08-15 (Phase 6 T1 fix for the S1 audit finding that claude-opus-5/claude-sonnet-5 were missing and silently fell through to a stale default-model rate — see CHANGELOG.md 0.10.2). Each model entry carries its own 'as_of'/'source_url' for the staleness guard (tes/cost.py's check_price_table_staleness, ported from adk-tracegauge's STALE_THRESHOLD_DAYS concept) — an entry without its own 'as_of' inherits the table-level date above. Retired models (marked 'retired': true) are exempt from the staleness guard: Anthropic no longer changes pricing for a retired model, so 'is this stale' doesn't apply — they're kept only to price historical sessions recorded before retirement, and their rates are the last-published figures at time of retirement, not re-verified against a live page that no longer lists them.

claude-fable-5.note: Added 2026-08-15 (0.10.2, S1 fix). Anthropic's most capable widely released model. Cache-hit rate $1.00/Mtok = exactly 0.1x base input.

claude-mythos-5.note: Added 2026-08-15 (0.10.2, S1 fix). Same capabilities/pricing as claude-fable-5; limited availability (Project Glasswing). Cache-hit rate $1.00/Mtok = exactly 0.1x base input.

claude-opus-5.note: Added 2026-08-15 (0.10.2, S1 fix) — this is the S1 audit's mainline finding: this model was previously MISSING from the table entirely and fell through to the claude-sonnet-4-6 default rate ($3/$15), undercharging every real Opus-5 call to ~60% of true cost. Current Claude flagship for complex agentic/coding work. Cache-hit rate $0.50/Mtok = exactly 0.1x base input.

claude-sonnet-5.note: Added 2026-08-15 (0.10.2, S1 fix) — the S1 audit's mainline finding: this model was previously MISSING from the table entirely and fell through to the claude-sonnet-4-6 default rate ($3/$15), overcharging every real Sonnet-5 call by 50%. $2/$10 was announced as introductory pricing through 2026-08-31 with a scheduled increase to $3/$15 on 2026-09-01 — platform.claude.com's own dated note (id claude-sonnet-5-introductory-pricing), re-fetched 2026-08-15, states that increase 'will not occur' and $2/$10 'is now the standard price'. Deliberately no promo_until/standard_rate fields: this is a settled standard rate, not an active promo, despite the historical 'introductory pricing' language. The 90-day staleness guard still forces a routine re-check regardless. Cache-hit rate $0.20/Mtok = exactly 0.1x base input.
